The Proving Ground

Centennial Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt · Concept and graded validation environments
A century ago this line unified how railways were measured. Today it should unify how AI is measured.

Overview map总览地图

The site is a narrow north-south strip about 1.374 km wide and 9.72 km long, a ratio near 1:7.1. Only a linear structure can run through it, so the line itself is designed as the instrument: a 9.66 km Baseline.

Three scope levels43.6 / 11.4 sq km · 368.4 ha

The research level decides what to validate, the overall level where validation happens, and the key-area level how it works. The three areas occupy only 32.4% of the overall design area; the remaining two thirds is connective ground, which is why the Baseline is the primary structure.

Land-use partition

Fifteen polygons form a complete partition with a residual of 93.8 sqm (0.00082%), no gaps and no overlaps.

Key areasL1 / L2 / L3

The three key areas are not three functional platters but three environment levels of one graded validation system. Promotion depends on a published baseline rather than administrative approval, and failure beyond threshold triggers automatic demotion.

L1 Zhongzhiyuan · Closed proving ground

Offline evaluation: real physics, controlled access, failure allowed
  • Reconfigurable test district
  • Shared test compute
  • Standards and baseline release

192.92 ha

L2 AI Origin Community · Semi-open pilot

Shadow / canary: real residents, informed consent and opt-out
  • Informed consent and opt-out
  • AI beside human service
  • Zero Point: measurement origin

104.32 ha

L3 Dazhongsi · Open deployment

Full production: fully open, requires failure fallback
  • Stock retrofit
  • Rail station link
  • Public reading plaza

72.05 ha

Transport, slow mobility, blue-green and public space基准线与计量节点

Green space is concentrated into one line rather than scattered: in an elongated site this yields an ecological corridor, walking continuity, and one shared observation section at once. The five metrology nodes are widenings of the Baseline: plazas spatially, public reading points functionally, landmarks culturally.

The public reading wall must also display failures. A wall showing only successes is not a reading wall but a billboard.

Buildings, land use and retain-renovate-demolish仅示意

26 building footprints total 72.80 ha with an illustrative coverage of 6.38%. These express cluster position and frontage only and constitute no scale or height conclusion.

Principles differ by level: L3 mainly retain and renovate, since existing large spaces suit open deployment; L2 mainly retain, because if residents leave the pilot loses its subject; L1 can take more new construction but must remain reconfigurable. These are principles, not parcel-level conclusions.

AI+ scenario cards12 cards

Each card follows one specification: task, measurable indicators, baseline source, passing threshold, failure fallback, data definition, and level. A scenario without a threshold is not an evaluation but a vision. These are methodological suggestions, not technical standards.

Phasing follows standard-first: phase one in the middle band at 180 ha completes the central Baseline, the Zero Point, and the first published baseline; phase two north at 365 ha; phase three south at 597 ha. Phase one succeeds not by floor area but by whether the first baseline is adopted externally.
